name: stock-trend-workstation
description: A股趋势筛选工作台 - 移动端App
author: Stock Trend Team

scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath ./App.xcarchive archive
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
